pages.description: Charms are a set of  curios enchanted  with strong  protection magics.  They range from  allowing you to walk  on Powdered Snow, to  saving you from the  Warden's powerful  Sonic Boom. Each  charm has a specific  amount of charges  available to protect  you. Once the  charges have been  depleted, pop them  into an Imbuement
chamber to charge  them back up.

pages.title: Darkvision
pages.description: This handy little charm imbues you with Night Vision when you're in a low-light environment.

pages.title: Decay's End
pages.description: Forged in the fires of the Nether by a Wither Skeleton mage in hopes of curing themself, this charm allows you to shrug off the the effects of Wither.

pages.title: Emberward
pages.description: This charm enables you to walk through fire and swim in lava.

pages.title: Ender Serenity
pages.description: This charm protects you from the angering gaze of the Enderman.

pages.title: Featherlight
pages.description: Upon falling further than 3 blocks, this charm will activate to grant you the blessing of feather fall.

pages.title: Gilded Friendship
pages.description: This charm of pure gold is used to peruse Bastions and interact with Piglin Brutes without drawing aggression.

pages.title: Ocean's Breath
pages.description: After your air bubbles have been depleted, this charm will allow you to keep breathing underwater.

pages.title: Resonant Shield
pages.description: Crafted by an Ancient Mage, this charm protects you from the sonic rage of the Warden.

pages.title: Second Wind
pages.description: This charm provides the gift of the Second Wind, allowing you to keep going upon receiving fatal damage.

pages.title: Snowstride
pages.description: This charm keeps you afloat over powdered snow, allowing you to walk over it without fear.

pages.title: Unyielding Magic
pages.description: This charm allows you to shrug off a Dispel, and keep all your powerful buffs active.

pages.title: Void's Salvation
pages.description: Once activated this charm will activate its warp magics and teleport you back to the last safe space you were on.
